goals.summary: Watch def 1 (orange). [RLCS; loose tier] Speed flip (play): jump, diagonal dodge 0.10 s later (side share 0.84, forward share 0.54), cancel 0.10 s after the dodge, wheels down 1.00 s after it, nose turned 24 deg from its pre-jump heading, horizontal speed 1432 to 2205 uu/s, boost held 100 % of the time from the jump, no ball touch within 1.5 s of the jump.
